description.value: 19 Okanagan Grill + Bar is an owner-operated steakhouse and full-service bar in West Kelowna, built around a philosophy of sourcing from local Okanagan farmers, winemakers, and producers. The menu spans steaks, burgers, salads, and appetizers, with private event space and an active local dining community. The same operator runs a second location, 19 Bistro @ Fitz, indicating an established presence in the region.
